description: Animates a still image with PixVerse V6, optionally with native audio. The output keeps the input image's aspect ratio.

duration.description: Length of the generated video in seconds (1-15).

seed.description: Seed for video generation (recorded, not reproducible).

dispatch_mode.description: Dispatch mode. "sync" (default) blocks until the job completes. "async" submits the job and returns immediately with a job ID; poll completion via `job_get`. Named `dispatch_mode` (not bare `mode`) so it never collides with provider-specific `mode` knobs (freepik DynamicCombo, pixverse motion mode, meshy pose mode, …).

generate_audio.description: Generate a native audio track together with the video. Audio raises the per-second rate.

img_id.description: Pre-existing PixVerse image handle from `createPartnerAsset({ model: 'pixverse/image-handle' })`. Mutually exclusive with `image`.

multi_clip.description: Let the model cut the video into several shots instead of one continuous take.

negative_prompt.description: Optional description of undesired elements. Empty is dropped.

style.description: Optional visual style. `none` leaves the model unstyled.
